repo.name: G2plot
repo.description: :dango:  An interactive and responsive charting library based on G2.

readme.summary: The README is primarily in Chinese with minimal English content, offering a basic install/usage example but lacking configuration docs, multiple examples, and any troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: README is written almost entirely in Chinese, making it inaccessible to non-Chinese-speaking users despite being an npm package with international reach.

common_complaints: Chart rendering failures (pie, funnel, water charts rendering as blank or incorrect visuals)
Legend interaction bugs (click-to-filter causing display errors and state inconsistencies)
Data update issues (changeData not properly reflecting in UI components)
Performance degradation at high update frequencies (event listener accumulation, memory leaks)
Platform-specific rendering bugs (iOS padding and clipping issues)
sentiment.summary: Mixed health: multiple recent bugs reported with zero maintainer engagement, older unresolved issues (2021-2023) still open, and slow triage suggests resource constraints or deprioritization despite ongoing codebase updates.

red_flags: Lack of detailed explanations for complex issues
Suggesting upgrades to newer versions without clear benefits
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful but could benefit from more clarity, patience in handling repeated questions, and technical depth in explaining decisions. They also frequently suggest upgrading to newer versions without detailing the specific improvements or fixes.

concerns: 457 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months - issues accumulating without triage

Zero merged pull requests in past 6 months - no development activity

positive_signals: Very recent commit (12 days ago) indicates minimal ongoing touch
maintenance.summary: Package is effectively abandoned with a large unaddressed issue backlog, no recent releases, and zero development activity over the past 6 months despite a single recent commit.

changelog.summary: Changelog is well-categorized but lacks breaking changes and migration guides, making it incomplete for users.

governance.summary: The governance documentation for @antv/g2plot provides a clear decision-making process and a path from contributor to maintainer, indicating multiple maintainers with merge rights. However, there is no explicit succession plan in place.
